svg.title: Agent proposes a change
svg.desc: 1. The agent calls a draft tool such as suggest_price_change. 2. The server checks the scope and the store's modules, then writes a DRAFT row with a readable title and logs the call. 3. The draft appears in the owner's approval queue. 4. On approval with a PIN, the server claims the draft atomically so it can run only once, executes it, and records EXECUTED or FAILED. 5. A rejection is recorded as REJECTED, and both outcomes appear in the action log.
